failures.description: cloudbench-controller fails only under concurrent-gate load; passes alone on the same bytes
failures.evidence: Native exit 1 at 052ac6ce7: step environment 'resolve_github_token returned empty despite available controller credentials' (live api.github.com check), plus autoscale UNVERIFIED. The identical step passes alone under the exact gate wrapper (sudo -u boxes, systemd scope, env -i): /var/tmp/webdecoy-rca/env-wrapped-1.log and -2.log rc=0, and the full gate passes alone (/var/tmp/webdecoy-rca/branch-cloudbench.log GATE_RESULT exit=0). It fails only when other gates run beside it (the failing log shows 'Cloud benchmark controller is busy' contention). The diff touches no cloudbench or GitHub-token code.
